elevatedRequiresGapMap.note: quality-rubric/index.json familyCompletionContract.elevatedRequires, copied verbatim, mapped against Cohort 1's current state. None of the four Cohort 1 canaries have reached ELEVATED -- Codex returned NO GO and cohort-1-canary-scores.json CLOSURE_STATUS reads 'NOT SEALED'. This section explains WHY, item by item.

items.requirement: before defect ledger covers every applicable rubric dimension and names the dominant product defect
items.evidence: cohort-1-canary-scores.json proposedDimensionScores has exactly 6 entries (customization-tenant-divergence, typography-content, responsive-mobile, material-background-depth, adaptive-layout-density-rhythm, interaction-states-motion). The other 6 of 12 rubric dimensions (anatomy-composition, geometry-edge-shape, icons-multimodal, accessibility-input, i18n-content-rtl, lifecycle-data-resilience) have no scored entry anywhere in the receipt tree. This is the exact finding the receipt's own COMPLETION_CONTRACT_GAP section already admits.

items.evidence: Tree, content-string, viewport, state and tenant-path pairing is well evidenced by the round2/3/4/5 fixed/open blocks in cohort-1-canary-scores.json. container, locale, density and rhythm cannot be meaningfully 'paired before/after' because none of them vary at all in the current lab (see axisGapMap: containersPx, localesRuntime, density, rhythm) -- there is only ever one untested value, so before/after pairing across those specific axes is vacuous rather than demonstrated.

items.requirement: all applicable rubric dimensions have source-bound evidence and a before and after score
items.evidence: Same gap as item 1 -- 6 of 12 dimensions have zero score of either kind.

items.requirement: every applicable critical dimension is at least 4/5 after the change
items.evidence: Of the rubric's 8 critical:true dimensions, only 5 have any score: typography-content 5/5, adaptive-layout-density-rhythm 4/5, customization-tenant-divergence 5/5 (meet floor); responsive-mobile 2/5 and interaction-states-motion 3/5 (BELOW floor, both explicitly RETRACTED AND LOWERED per CLAIM_RETRACTIONS). The remaining 3 critical dimensions -- anatomy-composition, accessibility-input, i18n-content-rtl -- have no score at all, so they cannot be asserted at >=4/5 either.

items.requirement: weighted craft score clears the layer threshold after the change
items.evidence: No receipt computes an actual weighted sum across the 12 rubric dimensions x their declared weights. It is mathematically impossible to compute one honestly today because 6 of 12 dimension inputs are missing. The four canary 'proposedScore' values (96/95/95/96) in cohort-1-canary-scores.json are checked against rounds/index.json R1.exit's flat '>=95' bar, which is a DIFFERENT threshold source from quality-rubric/index.json's layerThresholds (90-95, varying by layer) -- the two are not shown to be the same number, and neither is derived from the 12-dimension weighted formula the rubric implies.

evidence.canonClosure: customization-model/index.json defines canonClosure = adjudicatedProposals / createdProposals, roundExit target 1. At least 2-3 proposals/questions are currently unadjudicated: DEF-02 (edge axis) pending art-direction ruling, DEF-04 (schema/allowlist disagreement) pending Codex adjudication, and the Dropdown-texture-vs-Popover-flat finding explicitly 'referred to Fable; not self-adjudicated' per currentOpenDefects. canonClosure is therefore < 1 today, with named evidence, not merely unproven.
evidence.pathParity: customization-model/index.json defines pathParity = equivalentNormalizedOutputs / activeControlsInScope, roundExit target 1. No receipt in the Cohort 1 tree computes this ratio directly. UNKNOWN.
evidence.resilience: customization-model/index.json defines resilience = passedGeometryContentStateCases / declaredCases, roundExit target 1, and the rubric's own resilienceCaseFloor law requires declaredCases to include every applicable stressMatrix case. Since the cases actually declared/exercised by Cohort 1 already omit most of the stressMatrix floor (this whole receipt), any resilience=1 computed only against what WAS declared would be computed against an under-scoped denominator -- the same category error the audit exists to correct. No such computation was found in the receipts, but if one is produced later, it must use the FULL stressMatrix floor as declaredCases, not the subset actually exercised.

items.roundApplicabilityNote: rounds/index.json places 'canonClosure equals 1' and 'pathParity equals 1' as R5 (Cross-system canon and propagation closure) EXIT criteria, not R1 exit criteria -- R1's own exit list does not name them. They remain part of the general per-family elevatedRequires contract that governs any family's ELEVATED claim regardless of round, so they still apply here; this note is recorded so the R5-vs-R1 distinction is not lost, per the instruction to justify rather than assert inapplicability.

corrections: CTRL-04 is RESOLVED and SUPERSEDED — the map treats it as open. Control depth diverges (BitHire keyline highlight vs ledger flat) after the full preservation sequence.

normal / en / ltr as ambient defaults are PARTIAL, not covered — an ambient default with no assertion is not evidence.
